race.title: Bangor-On-Dee Memberships Now On Sale Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: A competitive affair but HARD DEALT makes plenty of appeal just 4 days on from making a winning chase debut at Warwick, a quick turnaround only a minor concern given the ease of that success. Dig Deep should make a superior chaser to a hurdler and rates as an interesting chase newcomer, with Perth winner Berkenshtaaap also considered in his hat-trick bid. HARD DEALT (IRE) DIG DEEP (IRE) BERKENSHTAAAP (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Hard Dealt (4/1), Berkenshtaaap (9/2), Dig Deep (5/1), They Want Me (5/1), French Emperor (6/1), Kingbel Du Lion (8/1), Roi Du Risk (10/1), Chasing Glance (14/1), Lord Roco (25/1), The Burren Man (25/1), Cedar Row (33/1)
